description.value: The Blackfin Pub is a locally owned and operated oceanfront restaurant and pub perched at the edge of the Comox Marina on Vancouver Island, offering sweeping views of the Beaufort Mountains and Comox Glacier. The menu leans into Pacific Northwest seafood and locally sourced ingredients, with an extensive BC and Comox Valley wine list. Note that this is a 19+ establishment — all guests must be of legal drinking age to enter.

address.value: 132 Port Augusta Street, Comox, BC V9M 3N7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, locally-owned oceanfront pub at the Comox Marina with full food and drink service. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi mentions appear anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null. OSM opening hours show only 6 days (no Monday), while the website states 7 days a week — flagged as a discrepancy.
